## Description of Changes
A concise summary of the pull request and what problem it resolves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Architectural / Refactoring improvement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Ran `pytest tests/ -v` locally and all tests passed.
- [ ] Tested on Staff Copilot UI dashboard.
- [ ] Validated with synthetic data fixtures.

## Mandatory Compliance Checklist
- [ ] **NO Real Student Data:** Confirmed no real university student data or credentials have been committed.
- [ ] **Human-in-the-Loop:** Verified that no irreversible university decisions are executed autonomously without human staff approval.
- [ ] **Grounded Knowledge:** RAG modifications adhere to approved university policies only.
